Arjun Bijlani Defends Comments on Wife's Eating Habits Amid Body-Shaming Accusations

Actor Arjun Bijlani has responded to online criticism accusing him of body-shaming his wife. The controversy arose from comments Bijlani made about his wife's eating habits during the show 'Pati Patni Aur Panga 2'. He defended his remarks, stating he does not care about the trolls' opinions.
